title.narrative: COVID-19: Active Response and Economic Support Program

description.narrative: The program is part of a coordinated package of Asian Development Bank (ADB) support to mitigate the severe socioeconomic and potential health impacts caused by the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic by supporting the government's Economic Response Plan (ERP). The program will help the government combat the entry and spread of COVID-19 and provide assistance to vulnerable groups, households, and businesses. This program is critical because the Cook Islands faces significant declines in international tourism and government revenue because of COVID-19.
